title: Dancing, and the Article You Drop
label: ch:bailar
canDo: I can say that I like dancing, dropping the article before the infinitive that I keep before the noun.

payoff.summary: Say both halves in one breath: me gusta la musica y me gusta bailar, and notice that la was said once and not twice.
payoff.note: The two lessons are deliberately a pair rather than two entries in a word list. Chapter 35 taught the inversion; this chapter is the first place the learner has to decide whether the liked thing carries an article, and the answer differs between the two halves. Closes A1-NE18-02 in the Instituto Cervantes A1 inventory, which had no corresponding atom in the corpus at all.
